biological_quantity: ESM-2 sequence embedding of heavy chain
source_input: heavy sequence only (bundle is H half of Stage2 split)
source_tool: HuggingFace transformers AutoModel (gate_b1) / fair-esm for residue pack
source_function: embed_esm (mean over AA tokens excluding specials)
notes: Canonical: top_models_feature_bundle/data/esm2_heavy.parquet. PCA=false in EXP-H047. Residue pack (FB path) uses fair-esm repr_layers=[33]; mean-pool vs this block max abs ~5.6e-6.

formula_or_algorithm: identical formulas to SEQ_BASIC; prefix seqA_ instead of seqB_
notes: SEQ_ALL = SEQ_BASIC (78) + physchem extras (37) = 115. No germline/CDR-length/ANARCI region families.

column19: GRAVY is Kyte-Doolittle mean via ProtParam (not Fauchère).

biological_quantity: AA Shannon entropy and unique count

column21: H not aromatic. Structure via STRUCTURE_INPUT_CROSSWALK_v2 esmfold_canonical_path.

biological_quantity: exposed aromatic SASA and fraction of total SASA
formula_or_algorithm: sum SASA of exposed aromatics; / total residue SASA
CDR among exposed aromatics; fraction = CDR_SASA / exposed_aromatic_SASA

biological_quantity: Cα contact patches among exposed aromatics
formula_or_algorithm: Edges if Cα distance ≤ PATCH_R=8Å among exposed aromatics; max_local = max_i Σ SASA of exposed aromatics within LOCAL_R=10Å of i

column18: count of F/W/Y regardless of exposure
column20: FEATURE_SPEC marks qc_not_canonical but present in frozen 19-d bundle.

formula_or_algorithm: H(s)=Σ_i π_i exp(−α‖s−x_i‖) for ‖s−x_i‖≤7Å; α=1.0; π=Fauchère–Pliska; high-H = within-struct q≥0.80; patches link≤2Å
notes: ≠ STATIC-SAP (Black–Mould×RASA). Field itself not SASA-weighted; surface sampling ∝ atomic SASA; mean_H uses area weights.

biological_quantity: surface point count + electrostatic φ finite frac QC
source_input: same surface + APBS φ from copatch batch
formula_or_algorithm: n_points from hydro surface; phi_finite_frac = fraction of finite electrostatic potential values on surface points
notes: Outside FEATURE_SPEC canonical 14 but present in frozen 16-d bundle because batch2 co-wrote them.

biological_quantity: net-charge titration curve shape from structure pKa
formula_or_algorithm: acids −1/(1+10^(pKa−pH)); bases +1/(1+10^(pH−pka)); PH=4..10 step 0.25; dQ=np.gradient; exclude N+/C- from primary Q; exclude CYS pKa≥99
notes: No pI zero-crossing feature in this family (sequence pI is in SEQ_ALL).

formula_or_algorithm: termini-inclusive Q at 7.4 and site counts

biological_quantity: RASA^1-weighted ESM-2 residue emb on Heavy IMGT CDR3
source_input: residue ESM2 H pack + RASA cache
aggregation: w_i=clip(RASA_i,0,1)^1; pooled=Σ w_i e_i / Σ w_i
